extracted text: The paper focuses on AA2219 aluminum alloy in T87 condition subjected to various cryorolling processes. The cryorolling was done in three different conditions: (1) without solution treatment (WST-CR), (2) with solution treatment (ST+CR), and (3) solution treated, cryorolled, and annealed (CR+Annealed). Solution treatment was performed at 808 K (535°C) for 1 hour, followed by water quenching. Annealing was done at 623 K (350°C) for 1 hour. The paper mentions that AA2219 contains Cu as the main alloying element (described as an Al-Cu alloy), with fine semicoherent θ' precipitates (secondary CuAl2) being the main strengthening phase. The alloy also contains intermetallic compounds (Al6Mn, Al7Cu2Fe).
